name: Should I get multiple repair estimates for my San Diego car accident?

mainEntity.name: Should I get multiple repair estimates for my San Diego car accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s advisable to get at least 2-3 independent estimates to prevent insurance undervaluing your repairs and ensure full coverage. This strengthens your property damage claim.missionlegalcenter+1​
